reason: Schedule and feasibility lens. The calendar has slack, but the plan cannot run as written. An honestly validated, scored probe has P ~0.10 against the 0.70 needed. Six problems. (1) The lab it relies on does not replay these knobs. Friend A's pending task (PROMPT_FRIEND_A.md top block; CONTEXT.md L1543-1546) is a cache in replay.py format (raw/ ckpt/ dc/ divnet/). It is for division insertion. replay.py has no flow relink, readmit or gapfill: grep finds 0 hits. The cache has no low-det peak dump, and readmit and gapfill draw their peaks from that dump. So FLOW_TIGHT_UM and READMIT_RADIUS_UM cannot be replayed from it on CPU. Only linefit could be, and only if a pre-linefit graph is dumped. Friend A is also unconfirmed: no commits since 24 Sep ~01:12 UTC, PC rebooted, told to wait for #34. (2) One resource line is phantom, one is misattributed. tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 --set already passes env overrides: they are appended to cell 0 after x138's own os.environ lines. A dry run in a scratch copy wrote BIOHUB_OUTPUT_LINEFIT_WEIGHT=0.65 and BIOHUB_MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_TIGHT_UM=6.5 correctly. So the 1.5 h pass-through costs ~0. The real agent cost is the lab, which the idea does not budget. (3) GPU cost is 3-4x the idea's '6 h'. x138 takes ~3.5-4.5 min per video on a T4 (sibling divins schedule notes). The official protocol is 64 selection + 135 confirmation videos, plus 4-7 configs of the full x138 tail replayed per video. The DeepCenter veto needs frames and the GPU. That comes to ~22-25 GPU-h, about 80% of vitalii's 30 GPU-h left for the rest of the competition. It collides with the divins x138 cache (13-16 GPU-h) and with every probe's dummy run (~0.7 GPU-h each). Sasyami's quota needs friend A. (4) Runtime traps. REPAIR_DEADLINE_S is 27000 s from kernel start. The validator calls the same filter_output_graph, so any lab session past 7.5 h silently turns off relink, gap close, safe divisions and linefit. Shards must stay <= ~5 h or the lab must raise the deadline. (5) The pre-registered gate is almost unpassable at this effect size. It asks for >= +0.002 on confirmation, CI90 > 0 and both embryos >= 0, then shades one step toward the default. The idea's own ceiling is +0.003-0.004. The sibling value verdict gives the linefit shift ~+0.0001-0.0003 (B28 curvature: RESULTS.md L108 w0.5 .8948 / w0.8 .9001 / w1.0 .8955 on only 12 LOEO-44b6 videos). So P(gate pass) is ~0.15-0.25, and a failed gate correctly spends no slot. (6) Even a scored probe decides nothing. The adoption rule, >= base + 0.001, sits inside LB noise ~0.003-0.004 (byte-identical notebooks 0.946/0.942; BRIEF sec.1). Justin CH123 found the LB tracks node-count changes, not offline J (browser_research_2026-09-24.md L93). READMIT radius and the gate change node count. Joint P(an honestly validated tail knob scored before 29 Sep 10:00Z) = P(#34 >= 0.952) ~0.75 x P(the lab runs clean on Sat with Vitalii present to push and download) ~0.65 x P(gate) ~0.2 = ~0.10. Shipping without the gate raises it to ~0.5 but is not honest validation. Cited numbers check out: linefit +0.0145 (RESULTS.md L104, 12 videos, exp29 stack, grid coords); tail knobs 7.0/4/3.5 (DIFF.md L69-71); 52% densest quartile (r2_critic). New fact the idea missed: x138 already contains a dormant in-kernel validator plus PP-sweep harness (cells 7-10). It is disabled by BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE=0 (DIFF.md L68). It predicts train stems and replays x138's full filter_output_graph (TEST_DIR swapped to TRAIN_DIR, DeepCenter bundle passed) per config with the official formula. It is the cheapest honest x138 tail lab, and it removes the friend A dependency.
fix_if_any: Run no standalone tail grid. Repaired minimal version: (a) Do not wait for friend A's replay.py cache. Build a new builder patch 'tailab' on --base x138, ~2-3 h agent work, container, with byte no-op tests. It turns on x138's own validator (BIOHUB_VALIDATOR_ENABLE=1), takes the stem list from env (splits.json selection or confirmation, shard k of n), adds MOTION_RELINK_FLOW_TIGHT_UM, READMIT_RADIUS_UM, OUTPUT_LINEFIT_WEIGHT and OUTPUT_LINEFIT_WINDOW to PP_SWEEP_KEYS (pp_apply raises KeyError otherwise), replaces PP_CANDIDATES, sets PPSWEEP_SELECT_MARGIN=99 so the submission is never rewritten, and sets REPAIR_DEADLINE_S=40000. Per-stem rows already go to validator_results.csv (t_pred for the multiplier split). (b) Cut the grid to 4 pre-registered one-step candidates in the hypothesised direction: linefit w0.65, win1, flow tight 6.5, readmit 3. (c) Better: merge it with the divins x138 train cache kernel, so one 199-video prediction pass (13-16 GPU-h) serves both lines, and the tail configs cost only the replay time (~1 min per video per config, a guess the pilot must measure). (d) Hard stops: the pilot must pass by 26 Sep 02:00Z (timing, 'readmitted' log lines present, the base replay matches the kernel's own final graph), and confirmation must be done by 27 Sep 12:00Z. (e) If a knob passes the gate, do not spend a solo slot. Ship it as a rider (--set) on an x138-based probe already going out, because a solo probe cannot resolve +0.0005 at noise 0.003.
